display_name: Attuned Malice of the Corruptor D
help: UNIQUE -- No more than 1 enhancement of this type may be slotted by a character.  Enhances the damage by {Boost.Attrib.Damage.Scale}% and reduces endurance cost by {Boost.Attrib.Endurance.Scale}% and reduces recharge time by {Boost.Attrib.Recharge.Scale}%.   This enhancement can only be slotted by Corruptors and may be slotted into any Corruptor damage power.
power_short_helps: Enhances Damage, Reduces Endurance Cost, and Increases Attack Rate
